nodes.label: Chip
nodes.rationale: Corner md. Active fill is the role color and the text follows the luminance rule. Idle fill is the role color at alpha 0x18.

nodes.label: Dock
nodes.rationale: Fill is the nav layer token. The active tab is foreground plus a primary line. The idle tab is muted-foreground. Related measures are nav height 100 dp, fab 88 dp, and radial node 48 dp.

nodes.label: Emobilize Design System
nodes.rationale: Visual system for Emobilize. Color tokens come from the shadcn registry @shadcn/theme-neutral, type is Montserrat, and layout units follow the Tailwind scale used by shadcn. Code sources are Shadcn.kt, Palette.kt, Type.kt, Metrics.kt, and Theme.kt.

nodes.label: Input
nodes.rationale: Corner lg, fill background, 1 dp input border, destructive border when invalid, primary cursor, muted-foreground placeholder.

nodes.label: Neutral Dark
nodes.rationale: Near-black palette, code name NeutralDark. Status bar and navigation bar are light.

nodes.label: Neutral Light
nodes.rationale: Default palette, code name NeutralLight. Status bar and navigation bar are dark on a light background.

nodes.label: Sheet
nodes.rationale: Top corners xl, fill popover, 1 dp border, scrim from the layer tokens. The close control is a secondary circle with a secondary-foreground icon.

nodes.label: Toggle
nodes.rationale: Corner md. Active state uses primary fill and border with primary-foreground text. Idle state is a transparent fill, a border line, and muted-foreground text.

nodes.label: :app:assembleDebug
nodes.rationale: Builds the debug APK as the last step of the check job, after unit tests.

nodes.label: check
nodes.rationale: Job name is Build, test, and resolve dependencies. It runs on ubuntu-latest with a 30 minute timeout and contents read permission. Gradle calls use --stacktrace. The job does not submit a dependency graph.

nodes.label: CI
nodes.rationale: Runs on every push and every pull request. One workflow holds a verification job and a separate dependency-graph submission job.

nodes.label: dependency-graph
nodes.rationale: Submits the Gradle dependency graph only when the event is a push and the ref is refs/heads/main, so pull requests do not submit. It needs contents write. Test and lint configurations are excluded, and the configuration cache is turned off for the submission.

nodes.label: Gradle dependency submission
nodes.rationale: Uses gradle/actions/dependency-submission@v6 with additional-arguments --no-configuration-cache and dependency-graph-exclude-configurations matching test or lint. This action replaces the setup-gradle step used by the check job.

nodes.label: :app:resolveCiDependencies
nodes.rationale: First Gradle step of the check job. It resolves the app module dependencies before tests and APK assembly.

nodes.label: :app:testDebugUnitTest
nodes.rationale: Debug unit-test task for the app module. It runs after dependency resolution and before the debug APK is assembled.

nodes.label: compileDebugKotlin
nodes.rationale: After a UI edit, run gradlew.bat :app:compileDebugKotlin --offline. adb is not on PATH, so a successful compile does not mean the UI was tried on a device.

nodes.label: Emobilize
nodes.rationale: Android app built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, not React, Tailwind, or Figma Make. Agents that change UI must read CONTEXT.md and DESIGN.md first and must ignore the user-level AGENTS.md, which belongs to a different web project. Change appearance only; do not change save behavior, filters, or architecture. Existing UI copy stays English. Branch tasks-radial-menu. Remote https://github.com/Hzxon/Emobilize. Package ayodong.emobilize. One Gradle module :app. minSdk 28. compileSdk and targetSdk 37.

nodes.label: Android SDK
nodes.rationale: Both jobs install the Android SDK with android-actions/setup-android@v4. The check job also sets up Gradle with gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6; the dependency-graph job does not.

nodes.label: JDK 25 Temurin
nodes.rationale: Both jobs set up Temurin JDK 25 with actions/setup-java@v5 before any Gradle step.

nodes.label: Layered architecture
nodes.rationale: The dependency direction is UI to ViewModel to use case to repository interface to data. Domain must not import Compose. TasksViewModel is the only ViewModel and it re-reads the repository after a write. There is no Hilt, and a DI library must not be added.

nodes.label: Cancel in-progress CI
nodes.rationale: The concurrency group is the workflow name plus the git ref. cancel-in-progress is true so a newer push or pull request replaces a stale run of this workflow on that ref.

nodes.label: AddTaskCard
nodes.rationale: Add surface on the Tasks tab only. The title is focused and the keyboard opens. Optional icons are Category, Priority, and Schedule. Schedule is Deadline or Time range, and tapping the same choice clears it. Close, an outside tap, or back saves when the title is filled; an empty title only dismisses. An invalid time range keeps the card open.

nodes.label: AppContainer
nodes.rationale: Manual composition root in di/AppContainer.kt. It exists because the app does not use Hilt.

nodes.label: AppMetrics
nodes.rationale: Spacing and card size in ui/theme/Metrics.kt. Includes cardRadius, cardMinHeight, pageHorizontal 18.dp, and headerHorizontal 24.dp. Change these instead of opening the ViewModel to restyle cards.

nodes.label: appStyle
nodes.rationale: Text helper in ui/theme/Type.kt, together with AppFont. The typeface is Montserrat. Sizes are specified in DESIGN.md.

nodes.label: BottomDock
nodes.rationale: Bottom dock with the Tasks and Calendar tabs, the center button face FabFace, and the theme orb ThemeOrb. The center button opens the radial menu.

nodes.label: CalendarFormSheet
nodes.rationale: Add and edit on the Calendar tab. It is not AddTaskCard. Add offers only Event and Regular Schedule; Task is absent. Editing an existing item locks the type to that item.

nodes.label: CalendarScreen
nodes.rationale: Month, Week, and Day, plus DayAgenda and AgendaRow. Under the date picker is a vertical card list, not an hour grid. Items sort by start time and timeless items go last. An empty day says Nothing scheduled. A block shows Regular Schedule, category, and start-to-end time. A task shows EventType, category, priority when set, and date or time. Edit and Delete select a card.

nodes.label: EmobilizeApp
nodes.rationale: Composes every screen and decides when a form appears. It is the UI root of the layered flow and must not own task or block data.

nodes.label: EventType
nodes.rationale: The three kinds are Event, Task, and Regular Schedule. Calendar Add offers only Event and Regular Schedule; Task is not in that form. Editing an existing calendar item locks the type.

nodes.label: InMemoryScheduleRepository
nodes.rationale: Data-layer schedule repository. It sits behind the repository interface and holds schedule data only in memory.

nodes.label: InMemoryTaskRepository
nodes.rationale: Data-layer task repository. It sits behind the repository interface and holds tasks only in memory.

nodes.label: Legacy model package
nodes.rationale: model/TaskModels.kt and model/CalendarModels.kt are old duplicates and are not imported. Live models are under domain/model/. Do not edit the legacy files.

nodes.label: LocalPalette
nodes.rationale: Screen colors come from LocalPalette.current in ui/theme/Palette.kt. There are exactly two themes, NeutralLight id 1 and NeutralDark id 2. Do not add a palette. Token values are specified in DESIGN.md.

nodes.label: MainActivity
nodes.rationale: Creates AppContainer, then obtains the ViewModel with viewModel(factory = TasksViewModelFactory(container)).

nodes.label: menuColor
nodes.rationale: CONTEXT assigns radial actions as Add green, Update blue, Edit actionEdit, and Delete danger. DESIGN.md instead maps add to primary, update to chart-3, edit to chart-4, and delete to destructive. Those two accounts do not match.

nodes.label: NeutralDark
nodes.rationale: Dark theme, palette id 2, provided by LocalPalette.

nodes.label: NeutralLight
nodes.rationale: Light theme, palette id 1, provided by LocalPalette.

nodes.label: RadialMenu
nodes.rationale: Actions are Add, Update, Edit, and Delete. Update is hidden on the Calendar tab. Animation is a spring with dampingRatio 0.75 and Spring.StiffnessMediumLow: the fan grows from the hub, buttons rise from the dock, and icons rotate 90 degrees. Do not replace these actions with a navigation menu.

nodes.label: Repository interfaces
nodes.rationale: domain/repository/Repositories.kt is the interface the use cases depend on. TasksViewModel re-reads through this boundary after a write. Implementations are the in-memory repositories.

nodes.label: SampleData
nodes.rationale: Seed content for the in-memory repositories. It is not a persistence layer.

nodes.label: ScheduleUseCases
nodes.rationale: Domain use-case layer for the schedule, between the ViewModel and the repository interface.

nodes.label: SettingsScreen
nodes.rationale: App preferences and categories. The gear icon in the header opens Settings. Theme is changed only from Settings.

nodes.label: shadcn scheme
nodes.rationale: palette.scheme from ui/theme/Shadcn.kt supplies background, popover, border, and card. The stored values are the DESIGN.md tokens, not a second palette.

nodes.label: Task
nodes.rationale: Domain model in domain/model/Task.kt. category and priority may be null. An empty deadline means no date. range holds a time range. eventType is Event, Task, or Regular Schedule. time and eventEndTime look like 10:30 AM; range fields look like 09:00.

nodes.label: TaskDraft
nodes.rationale: Kept in TasksViewModel.kt because its fields are mutableStateOf. It must not be moved into domain.

nodes.label: TaskFormSheet
nodes.rationale: Full sheet for editing a task, including DateField and TimeField. Edit does not reuse AddTaskCard.

nodes.label: TasksScreen
nodes.rationale: Task list, filters, and TaskCard. Filters are All, Today, Tomorrow, and Later. A card shows a category line, a priority badge, and a date only when that field exists. A task with no schedule appears only under All.

nodes.label: TasksViewModel
nodes.rationale: The only ViewModel. Composables must not change data state; that state lives here. After a write it re-reads the repository. deleteSelectedBlock() removes the selected calendar block. Do not open the ViewModel just to change card color or spacing. TaskDraft stays in this file.

nodes.label: TaskUseCases
nodes.rationale: Domain use-case layer for tasks, between the ViewModel and the repository interface. Domain code must not import Compose.

nodes.label: TimeBlock
nodes.rationale: Fields are id, title, start, end as decimal hours, and category. Stored per LocalDate. Shown on the calendar as a Regular Schedule block.

nodes.label: Chart tokens
nodes.rationale: chart-1 is Study and in-progress, chart-2 is Health, done, and low priority, chart-3 is University and the update action, chart-4 is Personal, medium priority, and the edit action, chart-5 is Work. Light and dark hues differ; light chart-3 is #274754 and dark chart-3 is #E88C30.

nodes.label: Neutral color tokens
nodes.rationale: Shared names across both palettes: background, foreground, card, card-foreground, popover, popover-foreground, primary, primary-foreground, secondary, secondary-foreground, muted, muted-foreground, accent, accent-foreground, destructive, destructive-foreground, border, input, ring, and chart-1 through chart-5. Card and page background use the same color and are separated by a 1 dp border, not by a lighter card fill.

nodes.label: Layer tokens
nodes.rationale: scrim, nav, shadow, and text-subtle. scrim is black at 40 percent in light and 62 percent in dark, over the radial menu and sheets. nav is background at 96 percent light and 97 percent dark for the bottom dock. shadow is black at 6 percent light and 35 percent dark. text-subtle is muted-foreground at 62 percent for completed tasks. Text on a fill uses ink when luminance is above 0.72, otherwise on-dark #FAFAFA.

nodes.label: Montserrat
nodes.rationale: Font files are montserrat_regular, montserrat_medium, montserrat_semibold, and montserrat_bold. The scale in sp is xs 12/16, sm 14/20, base 16/24, lg 18/28, xl 20/28, 2xl 24/32, 3xl 30/36, 4xl 36/40. Regular is for screen titles and body, Medium for labels, SemiBold for task names and field values, Bold for tabs, filters, chips, and buttons. Section labels are uppercase with about 0.1 em letter-spacing.

nodes.label: Primary button
nodes.rationale: Height 44 dp, corner lg, fill is the action color, and the label follows the luminance of that fill.

nodes.label: shadcn radius scale
nodes.rationale: Base --radius is 0.5rem (8 dp). sm is radius minus 4 (4 dp) for small controls, md is radius minus 2 (6 dp) for chips, badges, and toggles, lg is the radius (8 dp) for buttons, inputs, and date fields, xl is radius plus 4 (12 dp) for task cards and the top corners of sheets. A selected card outer corner is xl plus 4 dp.

nodes.label: @shadcn/theme-neutral
nodes.rationale: Upstream registry the palettes copy. Values are stored as HSL, the same way the registry stores them. Hex figures in the tables are sRGB conversions, not the stored form.

nodes.label: Spacing scale
nodes.rationale: Tailwind-like steps in dp: px 1, 1 is 4, 2 is 8, 3 is 12, 4 is 16, 5 is 20, 6 is 24, 8 is 32, 10 is 40. Screen measures already in use: header-horizontal 24, page-horizontal 18, card min height 68, action height 44, nav height 100, fab 88, radial node 48.

nodes.label: Task card
nodes.rationale: Corner xl (12 dp), fill card, 1 dp border when idle, 2 dp action color when selected, elevation from the shadow token.

nodes.label: Theme settings
nodes.rationale: Settings offers System, Light, and Dark. The header gear icon opens Settings. The document maps Neutral Light and Neutral Dark but does not say which palette System selects.

nodes.label: Composable UI state
nodes.rationale: The only state a Composable may own is themeId, the active tab, and menuOpen. A Composable must not persist tasks or blocks and must not build the task list or calendar blocks.

nodes.label: In-memory persistence
nodes.rationale: The product is a task and calendar app. Data is held in memory and is lost when the process dies. Sample content lives in SampleData.kt.

nodes.label: Product color roles
nodes.rationale: Product colors are not independent. Each role points at a chart token or destructive. Status todo is muted-foreground, progress is chart-1, done is chart-2. Categories: Study chart-1, Work chart-5, Health chart-2, Personal chart-4, University chart-3. Priority low is chart-2, medium chart-4, high destructive. Actions: add primary, update chart-3, edit chart-4, delete destructive. Selected fills are a low alpha of the role color with a stronger stroke.
